_comment: Editorial content for TSPL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: none of these fields has a licence-cleared photograph from the company, and a generic plant or product photo would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Tri-Star Power Limited generates, distributes, rents out power plant and supplies electricity. It was incorporated in 1993 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange; its generation facility at F/538, S.I.T.E., Karachi is not company property — the premises were obtained from a related party for installing the plant.
headOffice: A/33, Central Commercial Area, Block 7/8, KCHSU, Main Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (tristar.com.pk: corporate-information, contact) and the PSX company profile record, read 2026-10-17. No telephone number is published on the site.
